numerical_failure.observed_behavior: scipy.stats.trapezoid.fit fails to converge when no starting values are provided for c and d, defaulting to triangular distribution (c=d=1) with poor log-likelihood; the optimizer's initial simplex points become c=1.05 and d=1.05, which are not valid parameters to the triangular distribution
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: trapezoid.fit converges without starting values for c and d; default starting values are c=0.33, d=0.66 instead of c=d=1
trigger_conditions: fit called on scipy.stats.trapezoid without starting values for c and d
default starting values c=d=1 used (triangular distribution edge of bounds)

input_output_examples.input: scipy.stats.trapezoid.fit(rvs, floc=0, scale=1) with rvs = scipy.stats.trapezoid(0.3, 0.7, 0, 1).rvs(1000, random_state=42)
input_output_examples.buggy_output: fit does not converge; fitted c and d remain near 1.0 (triangular distribution)
input_output_examples.expected_output: fitted c and d not near (1.0, 1.0); the PR test asserts fitted values are not both within 0.01 of 1.0

category_specific_evidence: Original _fitstart in trapezoid_gen used default c=d=1 which does not converge (issue #23503 code comment: 'Arbitrary, but default c=d=1 doesn't converge')
Proposed fix overrides _fitstart to supply starting shape values c0=0.33, d0=0.66 while loc0 and scale0 are chosen by the general rv_continuous _fitstart
Passage notes c=d=1 fails due to being on the edge of bounds
Fitted result without starting values previously converged to the triangular distribution (c=d=1) with poor log-likelihood

Discussion notes the infrastructure ignores parameter guesses unless both are passed and never calls this function with args, so the final implementation falls back to args=(0.33, 0.66) only when args is None

Proposed test uses a seeded RNG (random_state=42, 1000 samples, true c=0.3, d=0.7, loc=0, scale=1) and a deterministic optimizer; reviewer suggested numpy.testing.assert_allclose against expected values with an appropriate tolerance (value not stated)
Iteration count, stopping criterion and exact tolerance of the optimizer are not stated in the passages
